title: AMRHZ Shared Intelligence Protocol
description: Governance and evidence protocol for human-led collaboration across independent AI systems in the AMRHZ ecosystem.

verification.scope: Canonical document publication and repository readback; runtime enforcement and external AI conformance excluded.

evidence.claim: The ASIP-13 specification is present in the canonical SYSBLOG main branch.
evidence.notes: Confirms document publication only; does not establish technical enforcement or conformance by external AI services.

limitations: This document is a governance specification, not an implemented identity provider or authorization engine.
External AI systems have not been independently tested for ASIP conformance.
The protocol does not itself create cross-provider connectivity or shared memory.
